additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477923-DC/Si-D/BE- [Multi] Load Balancing Activation CRM:03289000544
additional_info.body:
Hi Bart,
For bad connectivity, some corrective actions can be deployed, but mostly it depends if the connectivity issues are on router XF3 or XF4. In case the charger is offline on SCB due to connectivity issues on XF3, nothing can be done remotely but only onsite.
In general, in case of bad connectivity, you can:
Check the internet provider and the signal in Teltonika's webUI
Use a SIM card which can connect to different operators, or change SIM card provider, according to the best reception in the area
Implement an autoreboot configuration in the Teltonika's webUI
Implement an external router
Implement a wired connection
Hope these guidelines will help you. Of course, a more detailed troubleshooting analysis is required in case you are experiencing connectivity issues.
f you are experiencing issues on connectivity on any charger, please open a new ticket with ChargerIDs, timestamps, and symptoms if the issue is with XF3 or XF4.
As this ticket was for ELMS activation and the action has been completed, I will proceed to close it.
